notes.title: Patch Notes - Feb 22nd
notes.content:
This update focuses mostly on a small rebalancing of the Target Scores. The change is relatively minor, but should help a lot of you achieve the Target Scores with less frustration. You will still need to learn each level properly and be precise in your gameplay, but the new targets will allow for slightly more mistakes overall.

Let us know what you think of the change!

[b]NOTE:[/b] If you've already achieved the [i]updated Target Score[/i] for a level on a previous run, you will need to play through it again to get the Star.

[b]Specifics[/b]
- The second Target Score is adjusted by a set percentage for all levels
- The third Target Score is adjusted for all levels depending on the level's length [i](shorter levels get a very smaller change, and longer levels get a bigger change)[/i]
- Fixed typos and text going outside of textboxes in German, Norwegian and Russian

notes.title: Patch Notes - Feb 4th
notes.content:
[b]ADDED FEATURES & FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 4k resolution in Video Settings (this setting can also look better on 1440p screens)

[*] Textbox size adjustment, FRENCH: THE PARADISE - *Et ça fait un bien fou !*
[*] Textbox size adjustment, FRENCH: THE PARADISE - *Le sport, c'est excellent pour la santé !*

[/list]

notes.title: Meet the Rhythm Sprout devs, SURT Games, live at Next Fest!

Tune in today at 1pm PDT - 9pm GMT - 10pm CEST to watch it live, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/KnwKHGcTWt]Official Discord server[/url] if you want to ask them some questions before the live event starts!

[h3]Explore the new game modes[/h3]

notes.title: Rhythm Sprout just dropped a freshly new DEMO and trailer!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings lovely human beings![/h3]

Warm up your fingers to tap along to some fresh and funky beats!

Our rhythm action, Rhythm Sprout, invites you to join the musical adventure for the first time! 

[b]Play the new DEMO, Wishlist and subscribe to the Rhythm Sprout Newsletter. We will share more major updates and exclusive materials soon. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475840/

[h3][url=http://eepurl.com/hZDoNv]👉Click To Subscribe To Newsletter Now! 👈[/url][/h3]

At the heart of Rhythm Sprout lies a quirky mix of funky electronic music and adorably silly stories. Amp up the pace (and BPM) as you chop, slice and julienne your way through a rogue’s gallery of sugary opponents!

[h3]Watch this fresh trailer to start vibing now![/h3]
[previewyoutube=Bc5zD76cFqk;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

In Rhythm Sprout, you wake up as a little onion named Sprout. As the chosen savior of the vegetable kingdom, you are destined to defend the invasion from [b]the evil King Sugar Daddy and his Army of Sugary Sweets![/b] Use your sense of rhythm to defeat formidable enemies, rescue Princess Cauliflower and survive some bad jokes from the strange but adorable inhabitants. 

[b]If you cannot wait to grab the latest news on the game, show your high scores to the community or talk to fellow players about tips and preferences, join us in our brand new social channels! We are thrilled to grow our communities with you![/b]

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/RhythmSprout]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/RhythmSprout/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/RhythmSprout/]Instagram[/url] 
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/b94YvPZyVC]Discord[/url]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[u][h2]Fun features in this demo:[/h2][/u]

[b][h3]- Check out 3 playable levels with a scale of difficulty options[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IDODVLs.gif[/img]

Your rhythmic journey is set in a world filled with different seasons, themes, props and enemies. Hop through the picturesque seasons with a simple three-button control scheme and work your way up to a more bizarre and intriguing setting. 

[b][h3]- Jam to the varied OST[/h3][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D9dk4D1.gif[/img]

With an expanded adventure comes a more diverse list of tracks that were inspired by a variety of styles, genres and time-periods. Chill with a laid-back lo-fi inspired slow jam in Winter Woods or sneak into the Haunted Mansion with some gloomy Latino beats, all music fans are welcome. 

[b][h3]- Unravel the story[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39201042/3f9abca3c917069cd8f4f2685ed872269c1544d1.png[/img]

Find out more about the princess, your opponents and the kingdom in 3 story scenes in between battles!

[h3]- Stay tuned for more fun content to be shared in the near future![/h3]

[h3]Thank you for coming by lovely humans! We look forward to seeing you all in the beats![/h3]
